content.name: Sneha Reddy
content.title: Associate UX Designer
content.summary: Associate UX designer with a B.Tech in Computer Science from JNTU Hyderabad, a health-tech internship and two years designing a fintech savings app. Combines coding knowledge with user research in English, Telugu and Hindi; a simpler goal set-up flow I designed raised first-week savings activation by 17%.

experience.title: UX Design Intern
bullets: Interviewed 12 clinic receptionists to understand how they book and reschedule patient appointments.
Designed low- and high-fidelity screens for a Telugu and English appointment dashboard in Figma.
Tested the prototype with six receptionists and reduced the steps to reschedule a patient from seven to four.

experience.title: Associate UX Designer
bullets: Design features for a micro-savings app with 300,000 users, many of them first-time digital savers in tier-2 cities.
Simplified the savings goal set-up from five screens to three, which raised first-week activation by 17%.
Run weekly remote usability tests in Telugu, Hindi and English and share short video clips with the product team.
Work with front-end developers on handoff, using my React knowledge to suggest feasible interaction patterns.

achievements.title: Smart India Hackathon finalist
achievements.detail: Designed the interface for a crop price alert app that reached the national finals in 2023.

achievements.title: Design club lead
achievements.detail: Started the college's UI/UX club and ran Figma workshops for 80 students.
